rows.note: Use 份 as the all-purpose everyday noun for a share or personal interest in a business or situation.

example.english: I have a stake in the startup, so I’m happy when it makes money.
example.traditional: 我喺間初創公司有一份，所以公司賺錢我都開心。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 gaan1 co1 cong3 gung1 si1 jau5 jat1 fan2 so2 ji5 gung1 si1 zaan6 cin2 ngo5 dou1 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use 注碼 for the money or value put up in a bet, rather than a business share or physical post.

example.english: The stake I put on this game isn’t big, so I won’t feel too bad if I lose.
example.traditional: 今場波我落嘅注碼唔大，輸咗都唔會肉赤。
example.jyutping: gam1 coeng4 bo1 ngo5 lok6 ge3 zyu3 maa5 m4 daai6 syu1 zo2 dou1 m4 wui5 juk6 cek3

rows.note: Use 木樁 for a physical pointed post driven into the ground as a marker or support.

example.english: The workers drove a stake into the ground to secure the shed.
example.traditional: 工人將木樁打入泥地，固定住個棚。
example.jyutping: gung1 jan4 zoeng1 muk6 zong1 daa2 jap6 nai4 dei6 gu3 ding6 zyu6 go3 paang4
